crosshair_x.Description: Horizontal position of this participant's crosshair in the game's 2D world (Unity), on an origin-centred axis; at the start of each block this coordinate resets to -0.5 (P1) or +0.5 (P2).

crosshair_y.Description: Vertical position of this participant's crosshair in the game's 2D world (Unity), on an origin-centred axis; at the start of each block this coordinate resets to 0 (both participants).

crosshair_vx.Description: Horizontal velocity of this participant's crosshair: the per-second time-derivative of crosshair_x (Unity world units per second).

crosshair_vy.Description: Vertical velocity of this participant's crosshair: the per-second time-derivative of crosshair_y (Unity world units per second).

shot_confirm.Description: 1 on the sample a shot was fired by this participant, else 0.

shot_target.Description: Target type struck by this participant's shot. During a trial, values 1-3 equal the active condition code: the on-screen targets are the condition's colour (1 = black / AA alternating action, 2 = green / SA simultaneous action, 3 = blue / F free). 4 = white 'Bait' distractor. 0 = miss / no target.

score.Description: Cumulative block score ('fuel') shown on screen, shared across the dyad. Higher is better: it rises when the dyad hits the correct coloured targets and falls when a shot hits the white 'Bait' distractor. The task goal is to maximise it.
